bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12 by 6 by 12 inches are permitted and searched before entry. Non-clear bags receive additional screening.
allowed: Bags no larger than 12 by 6 by 12 inches
prohibited: Bags larger than 12 by 6 by 12 inches
bagPolicy.note: Coat and bag check is available for a fee, subject to capacity.

parking.note: No specific parking options or pricing details are provided on the venue's website. Visitors are encouraged to plan their visit considering the venue's downtown location and proximity to public transportation.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Brooklyn Paramount's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Brooklyn Paramount offers a sophisticated selection of beer, wine, spirits, and non-alcoholic beverages, along with light bites and snacks. There are seven bars throughout the venue to minimize wait times.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Limited storage is available for wheelchairs, canes, walkers, and other mobility devices. Nearby accessible subway stations include Jay St-MetroTech for A/C/F/R trains (0.4 miles), and Hoyt St for 2/3 trains, New Lots Av/Flatbush Av-bound only (0.2 miles).

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Brooklyn Paramount's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Brooklyn Paramount. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Brooklyn Paramount. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
